audit_type: Read-only deterministic text/id overlap and within-test dependence audit; no inference or retraining
normalization: Lowercase; replace every character outside ASCII a-z and space with a space; collapse whitespace; strip. Matches real_calls.normalized. Case, punctuation, numbers and non-ASCII text are discarded.
prior_caller_extraction: Uses the same Context/Evaluate-proposition boundaries and case-insensitive caller/receiver turn regex as train.caller_only. Audits every eligible prior training row, a superset of the sampled replay; excludes rows without the literal caller: substring, matching finetune_real.py.
limits: Exploratory evaluation: these benchmarks have been inspected repeatedly and informed later development; no fresh blinded generalization claim.
Scam labels are silver enforcement-provenance plus content-filter labels. Normal Switchboard labels derive from conversation context, not blinded fraud adjudication.
Positive and negative recorded classes come from different sources; source/style bias remains.
Zero normalized exact or ID overlap does not prove semantic, speaker, scenario or script independence. The banking roleplay development split can share speakers and scenarios with probes.
Positive test recordings cluster into script groups, and normal test conversations share speakers. Per-call descriptive iid confidence intervals do not account for that dependence.
This audit does not establish 99 percent accuracy, real-call probability calibration, streaming-prefix accuracy, deployment safety or audio-transcription robustness.
Earlier caller-only training is audited as the full eligible pool, not reconstructed sampled replay or training-only augmentation. File checksums identify the audited local inputs.
